title: What Is An App Factory
_note: Pilot explainer for Module M00. Captions are the narration (silent now, D3). Each scene: seconds, caption, screen words, icon, visual. Edit words here and run: npm run video -- M00-intro

scenes.caption: This is the App Factory. It turns one idea into a live, safe app.
Every app has the same four parts: screens you see, tables that hold data, rules, and people.
Most apps are hand-made from nothing. Each one has its own gaps.
A factory uses one road for every idea: nine stages, from Idea to Operate.
The stages happen in rooms, like Reception, Research, Rig, Reactor, Runway and Radar.
Between stages sit gates. Work moves on only when its checks pass.

scenes.screen: A Person Decides At Six Gates
scenes.caption: At six gates a person says yes or no. The rest open by themselves.
Apps are built from proven parts called bricks, sorted on eight shelves and grouped into kits.
Walls keep each business and each customer apart. They are tested again and again.
Same road, same checks, same parts. That is what makes a factory app safe.
